instruction: Fetch Let's Encrypt cert via acme_certificate module
output: ansible localhost -m acme_certificate -a 'acme_directory=https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory account_key_src=/etc/ssl/account.key challenge=dns csr=/etc/ssl/csr.pem dest=/etc/ssl/cert.pem'

instruction: Use the known_hosts module to add a host key
output: ansible all -m known_hosts -a 'name=github.com state=present key="{{ lookup("pipe", "ssh-keyscan github.com") }}"'
